<function name="SetTextStyleColor" parent="DLabelURL" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets the base text color of the <page>DLabelURL</page>. This is overridden by <page>DLabelURL:SetTextColor</page>.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="color" type="Color">The <page>Color</page> to set</arg>
	</args>
</function>
